journey.name: Today
journey.description: The app opens on Today. With nothing planned it leads to the plan; a session planned for today is up next there and starts from it; a preset that fits a few minutes starts from "Or pick by time"; and a program followed puts its next day up next, saying about how long it takes. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the Today tab is shown and selected, with "This week" and "Nothing planned"
Tap "5 min" under "Or pick by time"
Verify that "Tabata" is listed with its length and a "Start"
Verify that the workout shows "Get ready", then tap "Skip" and verify "Work" and "Round 1 of 8"
Tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the Today tab is shown again
Tap the "+" on today's weekday row in "Routine"
In the "Add to plan" sheet, tap "Lift", then "Add to plan"
Verify that Today shows "Up next · Today" with "Lift session" and a "Start session" button
Verify that the Today tab is shown, today's block on the week strip is filled, and the card under it says "Nothing more due" with "Edit plan", not "Nothing planned"
Tap "Edit plan", remove "Lift session" from today's weekday row in "Routine" (its "Remove" button), then tap "Back"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", tap "Follow a program", scroll to "15-minute kettlebell plan", tap it and tap "Follow this program"
Verify that Today shows "Up next · Today" with "15-minute kettlebell plan", a line starting "about 15 min" before "Day 1 of 18 · week 1", and a "Start day 1" button
